scenario_data.body: After holding Misaki in the park.
Misaki and I return to Famille together.
We return to Famille to find the rest of the house waiting for us.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "William! You shouldn't run away like that!"
I thought I'd be in trouble with Aki.

scenario_data.speaker: Aki
scenario_data.body: "You bought Misaki back, so it's alright."
Then everyone cuddles close to Misaki anxiously.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Hey! William, Misaki! Don't go off like that!"

scenario_data.speaker: Ren
scenario_data.body: "But we're glad you got back safely."
Tears begin flowing from Misaki's eyes.
With thoughts of her family and Famille,
tears flow ceaselessly from Misaki's eyes.
In the end, Misaki laughs through the tears.
Everyone is flustered at Misaki's words,
I take a breath and slowly say.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Of course, we'll always be with you Misaki..."
finally go back to our normal daily life.
A little after that, when summer has arrived properly.
One day, when I'm on my way back from university.
I look up at a noticeboard, and see a poster.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Summer festival... After all this, it'd be good to go with Misaki...)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Come to think of it... I still haven't told Misaki how I feel...)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Yes! I'll invite Misaki to the festival, and tell her then!)
I turn around, and see Misaki standing there looking confused.
Misaki looks up at the poster.
We are silent for a moment...
We laugh at the same time.

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "Should we go to the summer festival?"
Then the day of the summer festival arrives.
I finish getting ready, and wait for Misaki in the living room,
Misaki enters, wearing a colorful summer kimono.
She looks different to normal, and amazingly beautiful.
Misaki blushes a little, and smiles.
Just seeing that smile sets my heart thumping.
The main event of the festival is the annual fireworks.
When we arrive at the festival grounds, we walk around for a moment looking at the stalls.

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "Ah, the fireworks are about to start. Should we sit somewhere?"
Misaki and I move away from the crowd, and sit down on a side street, a little higher.

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "I'm glad you're here with me William."
We sit silently there for a moment.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I have something I want to tell you."

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "If you don't tell soon, the fireworks will start!"
When she says that I sigh a little.
Feeling like my chest is about to burst, I look at Misaki.
Just as I'm about to tell her, the fireworks start.
Misaki smiles up at the bright, glittering fireworks.
It's more beautiful than any expression I've seen before...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (This isn't the time to be staring at her...)
Misaki grabs my hand suddenly and pulls me towards her.

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "The fireworks are really loud, so I can't hear you unless you're close."

scenario_data.speaker: Misaki
scenario_data.body: "William, you wanted to tell me something?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "When I see you Misaki, I feels like I'm still a child..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I'll always be there for you Misaki!"
Misaki grabs both of my hands in hers.
We draw closer to each other...
Little by little, we get closer.
Then, we slowly part, with regret.
We look at each other again.
The fireworks lighting up the night sky give us their blessing,
as if confirming our happiness, we kiss again.
